p: God's stead: It is only God who makes one barren or fruitful, and therefore I am not at fault.
knees: I will receive her children on my lap, as though they were my own.
and I have prevailed: The arrogancy of man's nature appears in that she condemns her sister, after she has received this benefit from God to bear children.
A troop cometh: That is, God increases me with a multitude of children for so Jacob explains this name Gad Ge 49:19.
mandrakes in the field: Which is a kind of herb whose root has a likeness to the figure of a man.
maiden to my husband: Instead of acknowledging her fault she boasts as if God had rewarded her for it.
reproach: Because fruitfulness came as God's blessing, who said "Increase and multiply", barrenness was counted as a curse.
I provide for mine own house: The order of nature requires that every one provide for his own family.
and of such shall be my: That which is spotted, from now on.
righteousness answer for me in time: God shall attest to my righteous dealing by rewarding my labours.
took him rods of green poplar: Jacob used no deceit in this for it was God's commandment as he declares in Ge 31:9,11.
stronger cattle did conceive: As they which took the ram about September and brought forth about March: so the feebler in March and lamb in September.
